name: zmodel_update_small_poly_reject_thresholds
description: zModel::UpdateSmallPolyRejectThresholds caches doubled and twenty-times base reject-area thresholds for small-polygon rejection.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this zModel scene leaf setter; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zModel scene/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4804c0 validates a stdcall leaf function that loads baseRejectArea, adds it to itself, stores the doubled value to gModel_SmallPolyRejectArea2x, multiplies that doubled value by 10.0f, stores the result to gModel_SmallPolyRejectArea20x, and returns with callee cleanup.
The native smoke verifies positive and negative base reject-area values update the 2x and 20x threshold globals.
